subject: Global band recalibration and offer margin proposals
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate@talentpartners.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Initial: global band recalibration request

Hi Vanessa / Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, attached is the regional benchmark packet we put together for tech orgs with similar scale (Benchmarks_Q4_2026.pdf). High level observations:
- For senior IC bands (L5/L6) the West Coast 50th percentile market moved +6-9% year-over-year.
- Mid-market (non-coastal) shows a narrower shift (+3-5%) but higher variability by role.
- Cost-of-hire pressure suggests increasing offer "margins" (band midpoint to offer) by ~100-250 USD/month in select APAC and EMEA markets.

What we need from Redwood:
1) Your current level definitions and geo-premium multipliers (we just need a single-sheet summary).
2) List of open reqs and intended target bands for offers this quarter (so we can map to market comps).

I've copied the benchmark attachments and a template for the topline headcount sheet. If helpful, we can schedule an hour to walk through the delta scenarios.

Best,
Kate
Kate Miller | Director, TalentPartners Consulting

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@talentpartners.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: global band recalibration request

Thanks Kate — useful primer. Attaching our one-pager with current band multipliers and a rough list of active headcount (Hiring_Topline_Headcount.xlsx).

Notes for internal -- quick summary of gaps we should decide on before we finalize:
- Leveling ambiguity for two IC tracks (Infra and Serving Runtime): candidates between L4-L5 often land in the top of L4 or low L5 depending on domain experience. We should standardize a tie-breaker rule (years + repo + on-call ownership).
- Geo-premiums: currently set as fixed multipliers (e.g., SF: +18%, NY: +14%, Remote-US: 0%). Benchmarks suggest raising non-coastal hubs (Austin, Denver) by +3-5% and adding a small uplift for nearshore LATAM support hubs (+2%).
- Offer margins: for priority hires we should keep a 2-3% discretionary buffer above midpoint for final-round negotiations; explicit approval needed for >5% above midpoint.

Requesting: Laura, can you draft a concise leveling decision (tie-breaker rule) and proposed delta table (by role family) for review by Friday? Vivek — can you confirm headcount budget flexibility for the incremental uplift (likely ~0.6%-1.0% run-rate) so we can approve adjustments for offers? Neha — please confirm any regulatory or payroll implications for the proposed LATAM uplift.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Talent Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Global band recalibration and offer margin proposals

Team — draft attached below (inline + spreadsheet update). Quick bullets:

- Leveling tie-breaker (proposal): when cross-track ambiguity exists, prioritize (1) role-specific domain expertise, (2) sustained impact (2+ quarters), (3) product/code ownership. If still ambiguous, default to the lower level with a documented calibration note and manager approval.

- Proposed geo deltas (applies to base salary multipliers):
  * SF / Bay Area: no change to existing multiplier (retain +18%)
  * NY / Seattle: +1% adjustments to address competitive hiring pockets
  * Austin / Denver / Atlanta: +3%
  * Nearshore LATAM hubs (Mexico City, Santiago): +2% (pending payroll review)
  * EMEA core markets (London, Berlin): +2% midpoint uplift for L5-L6

- Offer margin policy:
  * Standard offers: up to 3% above midpoint auto-approved by recruiting/sr hiring manager
  * Manager-approved flex: up to 5% with rationale documented
  * Exec sign-off: >5% (Finance consult)

Rationale and bench: I mapped the Kate packet percentiles to our bands and show net impact: estimated blended comp increase of ~0.9% run-rate if we adopt all recommendations and keep the current headcount plan. Spreadsheet has per-req examples.

Attachment: updated Hiring_Topline_Headcount.xlsx (sheet: geo-deltas)

LM
Laura Bennett | VP People Strategy

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Global band recalibration and offer margin proposals

Appreciate the analysis — I ran a quick finance sensitivity against the hiring plan. Key points:
- The projected run-rate increase (~0.9%) is within our headroom for Q1 hiring; we can absorb the uplift without revising total approved headcount for H1.
- Caveat: if we accelerate hiring >20% beyond current plan, we should re-evaluate (sensitivity shows run-rate crosses 1.8%-2.2% at +25% hiring pace).

Decision item for exec review: approve the geo-delta table and offer margin policy as described by Laura (exec sign-off path for >5% remains). If agreed, we should update recruiting playbooks and compensation templates (recruiting ops to send amended offer letter templates).

Forwarding to Vanessa for formal sign-off and to request inclusion on next week's People Ops sync.

-Vivek
CFO (Finance lead for headcount planning)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: approve geo deltas and offer margins (Q1 rollout)

Thanks all — I reviewed the attachments and the financial sensitivity. Approvals:
- Approve geo-premium deltas as Laura proposed (Austin/Denver/Atlanta +3%, LATAM +2% pending payroll confirmation).
- Approve offer margin policy (<=3% auto; <=5% manager; >5% exec).
- Headcount: we will not increase total approved H1 headcount; recruiting should proceed against existing reqs with the new multipliers and margins.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Neha: confirm payroll/regulatory for LATAM uplift by Tue 12/08. (owner: neha_kapoor)
- Marissa: update offer letter templates and compensation artifact in Greenhouse by Wed 12/09. (owner: marissa_cole)
- Laura: publish a one-page leveling tie-breaker and the geo-delta table to the People Ops drive and include in the People Ops sync deck (owner: laura_bennett)
- Finance: Vivek will circulate a short FY run-rate note to CFO council for visibility (owner: vivek_kulkarni)

I'll add this set to next week's People Ops agenda and send a short comms note to hiring managers once Neha confirms LATAM. Good work — we should be able to move faster on offers with clearer guidance.

-Vanessa
